issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected return type and can make their implementations fail the automated checks (students following the UML may implement a String-returning method while tests and the solution expect an int).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML and problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and update any documentation text that mentions its return type. Alternatively, if the exercise intentionally expects a String, change the solution and template implementation to return String. Document the chosen return type in the task description so students implement the correct signature.
